test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held On: 30 June, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
‘A # B’ means ‘A is the brother of B’.

‘A @ B’ means ‘A is the daughter of B’.

‘A & B’ means ‘A is the husband of B’.

‘A % B’ means ‘A is the wife of B’.

If V & S @ F % H # T @ Q, then how is F related to Q?
solution:
Family Chart:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/47a89a5bb9daa01f32d67cf5151f1acc95989e845ae3c3eb86353e0d1da9cbdc.png] 

Decoding the Symbols:

 
 

 Symbol
 %
 #
 &
 @
 
 

 Meaning
 Wife
 Brother
 Husband
 Daughter
 
 

 

Given: V & S @ F % H # T @ Q

It means: V is the husband of S, S is the daughter of F, F is the wife of H, H is the brother of T, T is the daughter of Q,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/27e10202e0406fbdcc90534e6fc0d6e53c230d1c4023d1cfd98db7901153b30e.png] 

So, F is the 'Son’s wife' of Q.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4".**
